Messages.Author: ur_vampire
Messages.Body:
We had yesterday our VTES League final 2017 and in one situation, I´m not sure about the correct ruling, So the situation was:

Player A bleeds Player B. Block. Combat.
Player A plays Majesty at superior.
Player B plays Serpent´s Numbing Kiss at Superior.

Majesty untaps the Minion from player A. Does Serpent´s Numbing Kiss tap these minion again?

Majesty:
Presence
inf: Strike:combat ends.
sup:As above, and this vampire untaps before combat ends.
cost 1 blood

Serpent´s Numbing Kiss
presence/serpentis
inf: Strike:combat ends.
sup:As above, and if the range is close, this vampire burns 1 blood to put this card on the opposing minion and tap him or her. This minion does not untap as normal during your untap phase. Burn this card during your untap phase.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Majesty unlocks before combat ends.
Serpent's Numbing Kiss locks after the combat ends.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: TwoRazorReign
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Majesty unlocks before combat ends.
> Serpent's Numbing Kiss locks after the combat ends.
>
Huh. The card text on Serpent's Numbing Kiss does not indicate the tapping of and putting the card on the opposing minion happens after combat. Per card text, wouldn't this happen during strike resolution? Is there a rule or ruling indicating otherwise?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> TwoRazorReign wrote:
>
> > Ankha wrote:
> > Majesty unlocks before combat ends.
> > Serpent's Numbing Kiss locks after the combat ends.
> >
> Huh. The card text on Serpent's Numbing Kiss does not indicate the tapping of and putting the card on the opposing minion happens after combat. Per card text, wouldn't this happen during strike resolution? Is there a rule or ruling indicating otherwise?
>
It happens during strike resolution, but you follow the effects in order: combats ends, then <stuff>.

See also Loving Agony's damage, or Rötschreck vs Psyche!
